channel.title: SROTrac Weekly
channel.description: Weekly editions from the SRO register: rosters, recognition moves, consultations and enforcement signals across India's financial-sector SROs.

item.title: SROTrac Weekly #4: The register doubles to 18; IRDAI takes a knife to distribution economics
item.description: The register expands from 9 to 18 SRO bodies across RBI, SEBI, IRDAI and IBBI (774 member orgs); IRDAI's 23 September distribution consultation lands on the two insurance councils the same week they join; SEBI cancels 12 lapsed research analyst registrations.

item.title: SROTrac Weekly #3: UPI gets a price tag; rosters hold steady
item.description: Rosters hold at 642 members, but UPI's zero-fee era ends Oct 15 — 0.4% MDR above ₹2,000 reshapes the economics of SRPA's payment-operator members.

item.title: SROTrac Weekly #2: Register completes at nine SROs; FIMMDA stands up discipline
item.description: All nine RBI-recognised SROs now tracked on SROTrac. FIMMDA constituted its first disciplinary committee; GFF 2026 put regulatory gap-hopping on notice.

item.title: SROTrac Weekly #1 — UFF's licence, FEDAI's transition, and a tracker goes live
item.description: The week India got its second fintech SRO; what the full RBI SRO map looks like; why rosters matter and who won't publish theirs.
